def f3(g):
    from collections import Counter
    n=len(g)//3
    res=[]
    for i in range(n):
        row=[]
        for j in range(n):
            block=[g[3*i+di][3*j+dj] for di in range(3) for dj in range(3)]
            c=Counter(v for v in block if v!=5)
            row.append(c.most_common(1)[0][0] if c else 5)
        res.append(row)
    return res
